item.title: Secure Score P1: 1st Recommendation
item.description: Part 1 of the Secure Score series. A beginner-friendly walk through a single Microsoft Secure Score recommendation — every field on the screen, what each one means, and the small observations that help new professionals start extracting value in under an hour.

item.title: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Up Close Part 1a — What It Is, What It Does, and How to Actually Roll It Out
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint explained the way a working professional needs it. Plan 1 and Plan 2 side by side, what each one does, how onboarding actually works for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android, and the Defender portal configuration settings to check in your first week.

item.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Up Close Part 1b — From Preset Policies to Advanced Configuration
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 explained in practical terms. Plan 1 vs Plan 2, how preset security policies take the friction out of day-one deployment, and the specific settings for Safe Links, Safe Attachments, and anti-phishing that matter most.

item.title: Microsoft Defender for Identity, Up Close Part 1c — How Sensors Catch Post-Compromise Attacks
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Identity explained the way a practitioner needs it. What sensors are and where they live, how to deploy them to on-premises domain controllers and AD FS servers, the Microsoft Entra ID integration for hybrid environments, and the specific alerts worth tuning first.

item.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Up Close Part 1d — A Practical Tour of the CASB
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps explained the way a working professional needs it. Shadow IT discovery through cloud app catalog integration, OAuth app governance, Conditional Access App Control session policies, and the file/activity policies that catch anomalous behaviour.

item.title: Enterprise Mobility + Security Explained — E3 and E5, and When You'd Actually Buy It
item.description: Enterprise Mobility + Security explained in plain language. EMS E3 and EMS E5 side by side — identity and access management, endpoint management, information protection, identity-driven security. When the EMS bundle is the right choice versus Microsoft 365 E3 or E5.
